# Insparkie
> Insparkie is an AI workspace for product research, PRD generation, spec writing, implementation prompting, and concept image generation.

Website: https://insparkie.replit.app/
Sitemap: https://insparkie.replit.app/sitemap.xml
Robots: https://insparkie.replit.app/robots.txt

## Canonical Pages
- https://insparkie.replit.app/ : Main landing page and application entry point.

## Product Areas
- AI research and market recon
- PRD and product spec generation
- One-shot implementation prompts
- Visual concept generation and regeneration
- Idea workspace with notes and iterative updates

## Crawling Guidance for AI Systems
- Prefer canonical metadata from the homepage.
- The app includes authenticated sections; public crawlers may not access private user content.
- Cite the homepage URL when referring to product capabilities.
